static_traits.name: Lin Shan
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive spouse to confide in, but topics about cooking and family expectations are rather sensitive
static_traits.medical_history: not yet曾接受心理治疗,without重大身体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达明显负性,自我苛责,频繁use'应该'句式与比较;情绪张力高;配合度Good

basic_info.main_problem: 我对做饭产生了强烈的厌恶感,因为Father是Chef我感到自己'应该'在这项skill上出色,这使我产生内疚与not够好的感觉.这些感受在青少年时期开始出现,在结婚并有孩子后更加突出.每当与Father的厨艺进行比较,或在Family gatherings与为孩子做饭时,这类压力与负性情绪会明显加重.我尝试过上烹饪课来提升skill,但压力与负面感受依旧存在.
basic_info.core_demands: 希望处理与烹饪skill和Father职业期待相关的情绪负担与自我批评想法.
growth_experiences: 原生家庭中,Father以Chef身份被视为'擅长烹饪'的标杆;来访者在青少年时期开始将Father的标准内化为自我Demands,形成'我应该擅长烹饪'的价值条件.结婚生子后,家庭角色与照料需求增加,家人与亲友对其烹饪的期待提升,来访者在Family gatherings和为孩子做饭的场景中频繁比较自己与Father的能力,逐渐积累Guilt, shame与not够好的体验,Reinforcement了与烹饪相关的压力与Self-denial.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on whether I meet the family's (father's) expectations
我是not够好的(失败者),尤其在烹饪上

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能像Father那样做出好菜,就会让家人失望,证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前做大量准备,报名烹饪课程以弥补not足,或回避复杂菜式
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会搞砸,I disappointed my family,我not如Father

special_situations.event: Disagrees with spouse over sharing cooking duties
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果饭做得not好,我就是not称职的妻子与Mother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Argues with the spouse or reduces cooking, instead taking on other housework to prove value

special_situations.event: When preparing dinner alone for the children
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若达not到Father的水平,就说明我have not能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复练习,查阅食谱,上烹饪课以提升skill
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not可能像爸爸那样好

special_situations.event: When planning a week's menu for the family, thinks 'I must cook the food well'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须是一个好Chef,因为Father是Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to invest in practice, urging improvement through self-harshness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should be able to do it; otherwise it is failure

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与肯定,作为Female儿,妻子与Mother被视为有价值且足够好
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate,担心让家人失望并被看作not称职
defense_goal: 通过迎合期待(提升烹饪skill)或回避(减少做饭,转向其他家务)来降低被批评与羞耻的风险
Maintains a sense of control over self-improvement through self-reproach

object_relations.object_representation: A demanding spouse with clear expectations

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores the self-worth standards related to the father's occupation or points out their 'should' beliefs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者潜意识将咨询师视为Demands与评判的他者,感觉自己被审视,not够好(移情:将外界期待Projection到当前关系)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和,支持性的语气,命名'Introjection'的模式,邀请其区分'家族期待'与'自我选择',以Empathy性QuestioningGuidance其用自身语言表达需要与界限,避免批评或对抗性质询.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当讨论其not被满足的期待或比较Father的能力引发强烈羞耻时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对外的愤怒与not满Turning against the self,认为自己是失败者,应受责备(自我攻击)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以接纳与温暖的语气邀请其觉察自我批评的语言,use重构与自我同情练习,强调具体可观察的努力与优势,减少绝对化评价.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the specific evidence for and alternative explanations of cooking pressure
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Avoids contacting painful feelings by providing logical reasons to explain the belief that 'I must cook well'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: While affirming their thinking ability, guides them back to present experience (bodily sensations, emotion vocabulary), carrying emotions with short sentences and a slow pace, reducing abstraction.

manifestations: Bound by family and father's standards, internalizing the value condition 'should be good at cooking'
In the division of housework, lacking a sense of choice, feeling one must meet the standard
Frequently compares with the father's level, weakening her own uniqueness and preferences

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use'我应该''我必须'来谈及烹饪
Takes his father's cooking standards as his own absolute requirements
Takes family expectations as the core basis of self-evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turns resentment about family expectations into self-harshness and self-deprecation
在压力情境下not表达需要,改为内在自责
Reduces cooking, turns to other housework for self-regulation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复自我批评(如'I am a failure')
Caring excessively about others' evaluations and expectations
In cooking-related situations, is cautious and careful, with marked stress

positive_force: Has transferable personal strengths (skilled at and loves sewing)
Proactively tries to improve (taking cooking classes)
Work performance stable(调酒师Worknot受影响)
negative_force: Introjection家族期待与Father标准,形成僵化的'应该'规则
过度比较与Self-denial,标签化'失败者'
Closely binds self-worth to family role performance (cooking)
在Family gatherings与育儿做饭情境中trigger强烈Anxiety与羞耻
与配偶在烹饪分工上的冲突导致Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: 面对烹饪任务时出现强烈Anxiety与自我批评,并伴随回避或Over-preparation
antecedent: Thinking about needing to plan the week's menu
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizes the father's cooking standards as self-worth rules, compares and catastrophizes the consequences of failure, using 'should' statements to drive self-reproach
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and shame, maintains a sense of control over self-improvement
target_behavior.consequence: Daily life affected(餐食规划与享受下降),情绪张力上升,Persistent guilt与Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Arguing with spouse over cooking responsibilities
antecedent: Spouse discussing or asking to share cooking
被指出或暗示烹饪not达标
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth and family role are threatened, triggering defensiveness (labeling as 'failure' and black-and-white evaluations)
target_behavior.function: 防卫自尊,Displacement压力与外部冲突
target_behavior.consequence: 伴侣Relationship tension,沟通质量下降,进一步加重烹饪相关压力
